narrationDirection: Perform this original Thai suspense story as a native Bangkok Thai man telling an urgent incident to a friend. Use the same warm male narrator identity throughout. Keep connected, brisk conversational phrasing and varied stress; do not pause at each input scene or speak with the same rise/fall on each phrase. Start immediately with the phone/evidence dilemma. Flow through the escape geography without list-like cadence. In the chair misunderstanding allow a brief dry amused turn, then move on. The apparent retreat has a small moment of relief, interrupted by the rear footsteps. Make the threat quietly controlled and human, not a monster or movie-trailer bass. Build urgency toward the unsent clip and the difficult choice. Use natural thought-group breaths, avoid long empty gaps. No requested total duration. Read only the provided Thai text; do not speak these instructions or bracketed delivery tags.
